statement: A nurse counts $17$ heartbeats in $15$ seconds. At this rate, how many times does the heart beat in $1$ minute?

choices.misconception: I multiplied 17 by 60, as if the 17 beats happened in one second instead of 15 seconds.
I multiplied 17 by 3, thinking a minute holds three 15-second intervals instead of four.
I divided 60 by 15 to get 4 and then added the 4 to 17 instead of multiplying.

hints: How many $15$-second intervals are in one minute?
One minute is $60$ seconds, which is $60 \div 15 = 4$ intervals of $15$ seconds.
Each $15$-second interval has $17$ beats, so multiply $17$ by $4$.

solutions.reliable: One minute has $60 \div 15 = 4$ intervals of $15$ seconds, and each has $17$ beats. So the heart beats $17 \cdot 4 = 68$ times per minute.
solutions.elegant: Set up a proportion: $\frac{17 \text{ beats}}{15 \text{ s}} = \frac{b}{60 \text{ s}}$, so $b = \frac{17 \cdot 60}{15} = 68$.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
